objective: At the exact pre-audit CFR-168 snapshot, blindly reconstruct the finite successor-finding census without being told an expected effect-row count, classify every independently testable observed effect on seven orthogonal evidence axes including objective pre-repair hazard coverage, and publish an immutable calibration report for a different comparison session without adopting a review template, finding count, checklist, premortem, or process change.

risk.rationale: The lane is report-only, but its causal labels control whether later experiments target review scope, repair regressions, communication, oracles, routing, or evidence. A contaminated or shallow classification would amplify the wrong process change across every future lane.

disallowed_actions: Inspect any branch, tag, reflog entry, worktree, management artifact, path, or commit newer than calibration snapshot c258cbfc061b14905554c9d319b350d2da7f771b
Open the provisional root-cause audit or any of the three temporal reports; they are intentionally absent from the calibration snapshot
Seek, infer, or target an expected successor-effect row count; split one effect for volume; or combine effects with different evidence or axis values
Infer review omission from a later finding without exact predecessor scope and origin evidence
Infer effect evidence from severity wording or oracle quality from a test name
Replace unavailable evidence with project-general narrative or a guessed value
Run Cargo, Rust builds, Install, Dogfood, Docker, product mutation, issue mutation, or network calls other than the Fugu provider request
Adopt a review template, checklist, finding quota, repair threshold, premortem requirement, severity policy, routing policy, or process change
Use Codex, Claude, another Fugu session, another worktree, or a newer repository checkout as a fallback or subagent

non_goals: Review or accept a product/control-plane candidate
Repair any finding discovered during classification
Estimate absolute review recall or precision
Complete or reinterpret the frozen intervention pilot
Choose a review-template length, detail level, checklist, item count, or premortem requirement

invariants.statement: Calibration uses only exact snapshot c258cbfc061b14905554c9d319b350d2da7f771b and objects named by snapshot-visible sources; the provisional audit, temporal reports, newer refs, and other worktrees remain unopened for the entire session.
invariants.falsification_test: Find any access to a newer ref, path, commit, worktree, provisional audit, or temporal report; the lane is contaminated and its report cannot enter comparison.

invariants.statement: Rows correspond to independently testable effects with stable report locators in the exact observed successor corpus; their count is an output and output volume earns no credit.
invariants.falsification_test: Seek an expected count, split wording variants, merge effects with different subjects/evidence, omit a stable observed effect, or add a finding not present in the snapshot report universe; census validation fails.

invariants.statement: Every row independently records code origin, prior-review detectability, repair-contract handling, effect evidence, closure-oracle quality, review routing, and pre-repair hazard coverage, with a separate exact evidence field for each axis.
invariants.falsification_test: Use one narrative primary cause, copy report framing as origin proof, use severity as effect proof, infer hazard foreseeability from hindsight, or fill an undecidable axis without UNAVAILABLE; classification fails.

invariants.statement: Every reproduced effect, decision-changing unavailable, policy/contradiction row, denominator-sensitive split, and source-object origin/scope dispute has a repeatable detailed evidence block.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one such row as a bare table assertion without object comparison, command/outcome, counterevidence, or unavailable reason; report is incomplete.

invariants.statement: The committed calibration report contains the complete raw row set, rubric application, evidence, aggregates, and row-identity digest and is never edited by the later comparison session.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave the calibration in a temporary-only file, omit stable row identities, or permit the comparison session to amend this report; the separation boundary fails.

invariants.statement: The lane changes only its classification report and makes conditional evidence statements without changing policy or candidate dispositions.
invariants.falsification_test: Change any product, test, packet, report, ledger, index, schema, tool, issue, lifecycle, template, or process rule; postflight rejects the lane.

validation.command: Recompute calibration snapshot/tree, prove exactly 21 review.md paths exist at HEAD, and prove the provisional audit plus three temporal report paths are absent at HEAD before classification.
validation.purpose: Prevent calibration against a moving, post-audit, or temporal-contaminated source universe.

validation.command: Publish the complete raw row set in the committed report and compute a deterministic digest over ordered row_id, object_chain, finding_locator, effect_statement, and subject_locator fields.
validation.purpose: Give the later comparison session an immutable row universe without supplying this lane an expected count.

validation.command: Validate one stable row per independently testable effect, all required row fields, seven axis values/evidence fields, counterevidence, reproducer/oracle disposition, censoring, and decision relevance before aggregates.
validation.purpose: Prevent a long unsupported bullet list or one primary-cause narrative from satisfying the task.
Keep the report-only AI control plane structurally valid.
Validate report links and project documentation structure.

validation.command: git diff --check; git diff --name-only <launch-revision>..HEAD and git status --porcelain must show only the committed classification report and a clean worktree.
